name: Babinski sign
clinical_meaning: Supports an upper motor neuron lesion; it is normal in young infants.
notes: Phase-2 finding-specific content; topic-level source status.
concise_definition: Extensor great-toe response after plantar stimulation.
mechanism: Loss of corticospinal inhibition produces an extensor plantar response.
localization_value: Supports an upper motor neuron lesion; it is normal in young infants.
major_associated_diseases: Stroke, myelopathy, multiple sclerosis
important_mimics: Withdrawal response or poor technique
limitations: Technique, sedation, and age affect interpretation.
